text: This is a phone. It's also the controller: just tilt it.
Tilt to drop the blocks. Tilt to shatter the glass.
To hold off the invaders, and clear the maze.
To dive into the dark, turn gravity around, and fly straight through the rocks.
Turn it sideways and it's a steering wheel, back-seat driver included.
Underneath, Doom's engine runs as compute shaders on your GPU.
So do ten thousand lemmings. All at once.
Minesweeper, twice: sonar on the sea floor, or poop on the lawn.
Pull up a chair for mahjong or poker. Friends join by QR code, and the phones talk directly. No server. No accounts.
Plus the two that started it all.
Seventeen games. Every sound synthesized. Free, offline, and right in your browser.
